first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The bald figure in the image-left foreground with their back to the camera, with broad, thick shoulders and back, light-colored skin with broad red markings, and Weapon B and Weapon D carried on their back.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The bow-holding figure in the center, with long black hair, a green fitted garment, gray-blue skirt-like hanging panels, and leg wraps, maintaining a drawn-bow posture.

entities.name: Person C
entities.identification: The short-haired figure on Animal A's back, wearing a light gray-blue top, dark belt, and trousers.

entities.name: Animal A
entities.identification: The large gray-brown quadruped on the right, with dark body markings, thick curved horns, blue eyes, and a long tail, equipped with golden head armor, gray-green back armor, and a saddle.

entities.name: Dark Red Tree Canopy
entities.identification: The large area of dark red and pink leaf clusters and dark branching limbs at the top of the image.

entities.name: Weapon A
entities.identification: The spear extending diagonally toward the upper right in the foreground, with a narrow, elongated silver point and a long dark red cloth tied to its shaft.

entities.name: Orange-Patterned Object Lying on the Ground
entities.identification: The low-lying, irregular orange-brown object on the ground behind and to the image-right of Person B, with dark markings on its surface.

entities.name: Weapon B
entities.identification: The long-handled axe on Person A's back toward the image-right, with a broad silver-gray axe head and a long brown handle.

entities.name: Weapon C
entities.identification: The slender bow in Person B's hand, with its body nearly vertical and bearing alternating dark and light diagonal markings, and its thin string drawn toward the vicinity of the face.

entities.name: Stone-Framed Wooden-Stake Gate
entities.identification: The dark green-gray rectangular stone frame in the background and the uneven orange-brown vertical wooden stakes within the frame.

entities.name: Torch Beside the Gate
entities.identification: The torch with a visible yellow-orange flame to the image-left of the Stone-Framed Wooden-Stake Gate and behind Person B.

entities.name: Gray Stone Wall
entities.identification: The gray stone wall and dark area in the background on the right, with joints between the stones and roots covering the surface.

entities.name: Gnarled Vines on the Wall
entities.identification: The gnarled, branching thick gray-brown roots and thin vines along the background stone wall, interspersed with clusters of green leaves.

entities.name: Courtyard Stone-Paved Ground
entities.identification: The irregular blue-gray-green stone slabs, rubble, and adjoining narrow red-brown paving strips in the lower part of the image.

entities.name: Ground Moss
entities.identification: The green grass clumps, low moss-like cover, and a small number of broad leaves in the gaps between stones and on the midground ground.

entities.name: Courtyard Fungal Clusters
entities.identification: The clustered red-orange umbrella-shaped fungi on the ground in the middle-lower part of the image.

entities.name: Weapon D
entities.identification: The elongated silver-gray curved blade extending diagonally down toward the image-right from near the back of Person A's neck, with a dark brown wrapped grip.

At frame 0, Person A is a bald, heavily built figure with broad, thick shoulders and back; the exposed light-colored head, neck, shoulders, and back have broad red markings, and Person A wears brown leather protective gear.

At frame 0, Person A is bald and heavily built, with broad, thick shoulder and back muscles; the light-colored scalp, neck, shoulders, and bare back bear broad red markings. The brown leather protective gear includes shoulder straps and a horizontal strap in the lower part of the image; the horizontal strap has circular metal ornaments, and there is a dark fur-like trim beside the shoulder.

At frame 0, Person B has shoulder-length black hair and wears a green fitted garment, gray-blue skirt-like hanging panels, and cloth wraps around the lower legs; the arms are in a drawn-bow posture, with one extended and the other bent.

At frame 0, Person B has black hair falling to the shoulders and back and wears a dark green fitted garment with light-colored edging at the shoulder collar and multiple horizontal straps across the torso. The gray-blue skirt-like hanging panels have vertical folds, and blue-gray cloth is wrapped around the lower legs. One arm extends toward the image-right, while the other is bent near the face.

At frame 0, Person C has short hair and wears a light gray-blue top, a dark belt, and trousers; the upper body is upright, the image-left hand is near the waist and abdomen, and the image-right arm is already bent in front of the body.

At frame 0, Person C has short hair close to the head and wears a light gray-blue top, a dark belt, and trousers. The top has dark overlapping collar edging and bands at the cuffs, and the forearms have dark protective gear; the nearer trouser leg is visible beside the saddle armor. The upper body is upright, the image-left hand is near the waist and abdomen, and the image-right arm is bent in front of the body.

At frame 0, Animal A is a large quadruped with gray-brown fur bearing dark stripes and a long tail, thick curved horns on both sides of its head, golden head armor, and gray-green armor plates and a saddle on its back; its body is angled toward the image-right, and its face is turned somewhat toward the camera.

At frame 0, Animal A is a large quadruped with gray-brown fur bearing dark stripes and darker lower legs; its face has a light-colored muzzle, blue eyes, and an open mouth. The thick horns on both sides curve outward with their tips turned upward. The golden head armor has layered ridges, the gray-green back armor is arranged continuously and has pointed plate contours, the saddle and straps along the side of the body are visible, and the long tail extends rearward. Its body is angled toward the image-right, and its face is turned somewhat toward the camera.
At frame 0, the Dark Red Tree Canopy consists of large clusters of dark red and pink leaves and dark branching limbs.

At frame 0, the dark red and pink leaf clusters of the Dark Red Tree Canopy overlap in layers; the leaves have pointed tips, and some leaf edges have light-colored highlights. The dark brown thin branches fork repeatedly, and deep dark gaps are visible among the branches and leaves.
At frame 0, Weapon A is a spear with a narrow, elongated silver point at the front; its slender shaft angles toward the upper right of the image, and a long dark red cloth is tied to the shaft.

At frame 0, Weapon A is a thin-shafted spear; the narrow, elongated silver point is leaf-shaped and has a bright edge, and the shaft angles toward the upper right of the image. A long dark red cloth is fastened around the shaft and hangs down, with vertical folds on its surface; its lower part extends to the bottom edge of the image.
At frame 0, the Orange-Patterned Object Lying on the Ground is orange-brown, has a low-lying irregular outline, and bears dark markings on its surface.

At frame 0, the low-lying orange-brown surface of the Orange-Patterned Object Lying on the Ground bears irregular dark spots and short stripes; its upper edge is uneven, and its edges are partially occluded by blades of grass and small red pieces.
At frame 0, Weapon B is a long-handled axe with a broad silver-gray axe head and a long, straight brown handle.

At frame 0, Weapon B is a long-handled axe; the broad silver-gray axe head has a curved cutting edge, mottled light markings, and a dark opening near the axe neck. The long brown handle extends downward in a nearly straight line, and golden decoration is visible at the joint between the head and handle.
At frame 0, Weapon C is a slender bow whose body is nearly vertical and bears alternating dark and light diagonal markings; its thin string is drawn into a diagonal line.

At frame 0, Weapon C is a slender bow whose body is nearly vertical and slightly curved, with continuous alternating dark and light diagonal markings on its surface. The thin string is drawn from the upper and lower ends toward the vicinity of Person B's face, forming a clear drawn-bow outline.
At frame 0, the Stone-Framed Wooden-Stake Gate consists of a dark green-gray rectangular stone frame and orange-brown wooden stakes arranged vertically within the frame.

At frame 0, the dark green-gray rectangular stone frame of the Stone-Framed Wooden-Stake Gate has a rough surface, segmented joints, and a horizontal top beam. The orange-brown wooden stakes within the frame are arranged vertically, vary in thickness, have uneven top heights, and are partly pointed; dark gaps lie between the stakes.
At frame 0, a bright yellow-orange flame of the Torch Beside the Gate is visible, while most of its support shaft is occluded by Person B.

At frame 0, only part of the bright yellow-orange flame of the Torch Beside the Gate is visible; a brighter center and the surrounding orange glow can be distinguished, and the visible edge is irregular. The support shaft and the complete outline of the flame are occluded by Person B.
At frame 0, the Gray Stone Wall consists of gray stones; block-like joints, thick stone edges, and locally greenish mottled surfaces are visible, and the section on the right is deeply dark.
At frame 0, the Gnarled Vines on the Wall consist of thick light gray-brown roots, thin vines, and green clinging plants extending along the wall.

At frame 0, the thick gray-brown roots of the Gnarled Vines on the Wall hang vertically down the wall face, branch diagonally, and twist into knots; their surfaces have grooves and light-and-dark ridges. Thin vines wind among them, and small clusters of green leaves lie beside gaps between the roots.
At frame 0, the Courtyard Stone-Paved Ground consists of irregular blue-gray-green stone slabs and rubble, with narrow red-brown paving strips curving through the midground.

At frame 0, the blue-gray-green slabs of the Courtyard Stone-Paved Ground vary in size and have cracks, notches, and misaligned edges; small pieces of rubble are scattered near the joints. The red-brown paving band consists of multiple narrow strips laid side by side and curves through the grassy midground area.
At frame 0, the Ground Moss appears as large areas of green grass clumps and low moss, interspersed with larger green leaves.

At frame 0, the slender upright blades of the Ground Moss grow densely in patches, with a darker base visible in sparser areas. The low moss lies against the ground in patches; there are a small number of broader green leaves beside the stones, and the green vegetation varies in shade.
At frame 0, the Courtyard Fungal Clusters are clustered red-orange umbrella-shaped fungi.

At frame 0, the Courtyard Fungal Clusters consist of clustered red-orange umbrella-shaped fungi; the open caps vary in size and height, some slender stems are visible, and the lower portions are occluded by blades of grass.
